title: When the Orchard Breaks
author: Ivo Halloran
blurb: Theo Delacroix, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
